profileDimensions.rule: Do not infer diesel execution from series alone; factory period and later replacement/modernization must be considered.
Brake apparatus identity and routing require actual-equipment confirmation before variant-dependent instructions.

familyRules: Series name selects an information profile but never proves the exact installed equipment after overhaul or modernization.
TEM2U may inherit TEM2-family common content only where applicability is independently confirmed.
TEM2 electrical topology must not be assumed identical to TEM2U when the TEM2U manufacturer manual defines a dedicated circuit/execution.
Unknown execution blocks variant-dependent operational actions and forces clarification or safe generic guidance.
No TEM2UM, TEM2T or TEM2A feature enters TEM2/TEM2U profiles without a dedicated evidence-backed profile or explicit modernization record.

TEM2A: gauge/export execution-specific running gear and equipment
